title: Joining the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program
content:
Summit membership in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program is open only to individual travelers. A business profile cannot enroll; a company's travel is credited through a corporate travel agreement instead.

**Who may enroll.** A membership is opened only for a customer profile whose customer type is individual. The customer type on the customer profile record is what decides; a request made on behalf of a business profile does not qualify.

**Starting position.** Every new membership starts at Summit Member, with a tier basis of base and zero balances of award miles, qualifying dollars and upgrade certificates, whatever the traveler's past spend. Summit Chairman is granted only by invitation, recorded with a tier basis of invitation, and never by qualification alone.

**Activation.** The membership becomes active when its first activity posts, and it can earn from that first activity onward. Flights taken before the enrolment date are credited only through a retro-credit claim made inside the retro window.

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| Customer profile of type individual, no open membership | Membership opened at Summit Member, tier basis base, zero balances |
| Business customer profile | No membership opened |
| Membership just opened, nothing posted yet | Status enrolled |
| First activity posts | Status becomes active |
| Flight flown before the enrolment date | Credited only through a retro-credit claim inside the retro window |

**Hypothetical case.** A traveler who spent heavily with Crestline last year enrolls today. The membership opens at Summit Member with zero qualifying dollars; last year's spend gives no tier.
